deep_historical_M5.law: Minimum defensible history required for the frozen question and adequate power; no years by default. Power target must be frozen separately, never infer IID sample size from rows.

future_classification.cold_start_precedence: Proven authoritative late-start evidence => COLD_START_OR_LATE_JOIN_NOT_REJECTED; do not infer from missing bars alone.
future_classification.integrity_precedence: Proven identity/digest/canonical-row integrity contradiction => DATA_INTEGRITY_FAILURE, scoped to affected identity/shard; no whole-family null.
future_classification.metadata_precedence: Unresolved required current execution/friction fields => EXECUTION_OR_FRICTION_METADATA_LIMITED; retain every other dimension and reason.
future_classification.qualified_law: QUALIFIED requires every applicable dimension PASS under fully specified predecryption rules and coherent mechanism/context applicability. Any UNRESOLVED mandatory criterion blocks QUALIFIED. Current V1 has unresolved mandatory criteria and therefore does not certify any deep-eligible identity or authorize a screen.
future_classification.structural_precedence: Without integrity contradiction, authoritative current structural infeasibility => STRUCTURALLY_INFEASIBLE_FOR_CURRENT_EUR200_CONSTRAINT.
future_classification.support_default: Otherwise insufficient or unresolved support/calendar/activity => SUPPORT_LIMITED_NOT_REJECTED; distinguish unsupported from unresolved in full reason ledger.

future_step.planned: Separately audited and authorized machine-side decryption and outcome-blind structural screen of all MASTER1576 identities under an executable frozen protocol; resolve blocking rules prospectively first.

purpose: Freeze structural qualification laws before any shallow decryption; no threshold estimated from captured data.

rules.classification_rule: Evaluate every frozen MASTER identity in ascending symbol_id order; preserve broker-native asset_class contexts. Transport shards are not cohorts or independent strategy trials. Mechanism-specific coherent cohorts must be separately frozen before discovery; no best-symbol/context/horizon selection.

exact_thresholds.justification: Exact preexisting MASTER roster cardinality, not sample-size or profitability threshold.
exact_thresholds.name: identity_count

rules.classification_rule: Preserve original UTC M5 opens and original missingness masks in each of the four fixed calendar segments. Weekly broker schedule and timezone describe potential session opportunity, not a requirement that a bar exists in every open slot. Count expected opportunity only if metadata is proved applicable to the historical window, holiday exceptions and boundary semantics. No zero imputation or clock compression. Existing prototype inference support is not a universal acquisition floor.

exact_thresholds.justification: Existing acquisition calendar structure, not four independent trials.
exact_thresholds.name: segment_count

unresolved: Historically valid session calendar and exceptions are not certified by the later current-metadata snapshot. Schedule-based denominator remains UNRESOLVED until existing authoritative semantics/applicability are proved without inspecting captured bars.

Minimum eligible days/blocks, coverage fraction and maximum gap require a frozen mechanism, horizon, dependence and power requirement; none exists for this qualification protocol. Do not reuse prototype 7/12/42 gates.

rules.classification_rule: All four logical segment acquisitions must have explicit completion and integrity status. Later describe per-segment authentic row existence independently. Existing shallow-complete means at least one row in the whole window, not one per segment and not deep eligibility. A zero-row segment with no expected session is not failure; with uncertain calendar it is unresolved support. Absence alone cannot prove late join.

exact_thresholds.justification: Preexisting descriptive shallow-complete law; explicitly NOT sufficient for deep qualification.
exact_thresholds.name: shallow_complete_total_authentic_rows_min

unresolved: Minimum nonempty segments for deep qualification is mechanism-dependent and UNRESOLVED. No default 4/4 activity gate.
COLD_START_OR_LATE_JOIN requires authoritative listing/start or broker history evidence; first observed shallow bar alone is insufficient.

rules.classification_rule: Future integrity checks must bind exact identity, shard plaintext digest, manifest count, ordered unique timestamps, segment bounds and protected boundary. Valid canonical bars obey low<=open,close<=high and nonnegative integer tick volume; no repair/imputation. Integrity failure is reserved for a proven integrity contradiction, not low activity or session gaps. Keep complete reason ledger including ambiguous cases.

exact_thresholds.justification: Nonnegative integer volume schema, not an activity floor.
exact_thresholds.name: tick_volume_lower_bound

unresolved: Maximum tolerated missing-session fraction or consecutive gap is UNRESOLVED; absence of a trendbar is not proof of transport failure or no edge.

rules.classification_rule: Future tick volume presence, nonzero-volume bar fraction, active session days and nonflat fraction are descriptive support only. Broker-native tick volume is not comparable trade size across contexts. No return, volatility, profitability or historical winner rank is an eligibility score. Missing volume semantics blocks activity assessment, not global information family.
unresolved: Minimum tick volume, active days and nonflat fraction are UNRESOLVED: no preexisting source or mechanism-specific power target justifies exact numbers. Do not fit percentile cutoffs to shallow data.

authorities.locator: classify required fields and monetary gates

rules.classification_rule: Reuse accepted explicit commission type/rate/minimum/asset, conversion fields, min/step/max/lot volume, trading mode, shortability and minimum margin metadata with timestamp and units. Historical M5 OHLC cannot supply bid/ask spread, commission realization or slippage. Record unknown spread/slippage and historical validity as COST_UNRESOLVED; never replace unknown costs with zero. Current explicit zero monetary fields may be retained only for their accepted current meaning.
unresolved: Authentic historical side-aware spread and slippage observability/uncertainty tolerance are UNRESOLVED. Current schedule and margin snapshot does not certify historical execution costs.
A numeric friction-observability tolerance and safe economic headroom require later prospective execution law; no OHLC proxy authorized.

authorities.locator: classify: minimum-volume requested margin; max(buy,sell)>=Decimal(200); volume lattice and explicit units

rules.classification_rule: Use exact accepted current metadata classifier without relaxed gates. For the accepted bidirectional entry requirement, invalid mode/shortability or volume structure is structural nonfeasibility; missing/ambiguous units or identity is metadata limited. A minimum buy or sell margin >= EUR200 is structurally infeasible; lower margins prove only this necessary current minimum-position feasibility. Preserve prior 1576 structural-eligible census without calling it power, historical or economic certification. Do not extrapolate snapshot margins across time or portfolio.

exact_thresholds.justification: Existing classifier leaves no positive free margin at or above full account equity, for one or both required sides.
exact_thresholds.name: infeasible_minimum_margin_eur

exact_thresholds.justification: Existing classifier alignment law; no invented sizing heuristic.
exact_thresholds.name: volume_lattice

unresolved: Portfolio free-margin reserve, leverage stress, conversion validity through time and safe risk-size are UNRESOLVED; the accepted necessary minimum-margin test is not a sufficient survival constraint.

threshold_governance.unresolved_action: Stop criterion; use UNKNOWN, never assume pass or fail. Any successor numeric rule must be justified and frozen outcome-blind before decryption/screen; no threshold retuning after capture inspection.
